health.fat_nodes_hint: More trails than anyone can follow from one place.
health.locked_held: A live writer holds this forest. The lock releases itself when that process exits; it cannot be broken from here.
health.locked_orphan: A writer left its lock behind without exiting cleanly. Releasing it is safe — nobody is holding it.
health.locked_self: This Station itself holds the lock — the forest is serving.
health.needs_admin: The health report needs the admin capability on this forest.
health.needs_description_hint: Findable by filename and nothing else. Bind a vision model and re-describe, or write one by hand.
health.needs_split_hint: A branch this wide costs every reader that passes through it.
health.restore_note: Restoring over a live forest stays on the command line. A snapshot travels: the owner can download it here and import it as a new forest from the forest switcher.
health.scoped: This report covers the whole forest.
health.scoped_hint: It counts problems everywhere, so it needs an admin grant that is not limited to a branch.
health.snapshots_sub: The forest packaged as one file, full history included.
health.stale_passports_hint: The node stays; the file it came from is gone. The Ranger never deletes.
health.sub: What the Ranger would report on its next run. Reading it changes nothing.
health.title: Forest health
health.uncertain_hint: Links below full confidence, waiting for the Ranger to promote or prune them.
